'''Sentarr Laboratories''' was a small research [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] for the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]-owned [[Sentarr, Inc.]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The laboratory was located in the [[city/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], a Bothan colony world.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The laboratory was receiving exotic [[species/Legends|animals]] from all around [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and did tests on them, however behind this, they [[smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] some of them to the intergalactic [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="guide" />

Financially, the laboratory was at loss, but was supported by the parent company, and the smuggling activities.<ref name="guide" />
